title: fix(plugin-grid): the row menu offers no Delete on a line whose master is held
body:
Fixes #37231
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:列表页和相关列表里,主单正在审批中的明细行(如费用报销明细),行菜单和选中栏不再出现「删除」;自身在审批中的记录仍可删除。
- 为什么做:审批锁定的列表收口工作的一部分,服务端早已拒绝这种删除,界面现在提前不提供。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是某行该删的「删除」被隐藏或仍然出现;只影响按钮显示,不写数据,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

- `useRowApprovalLocks` now keeps the batch lock door's `lockSource` (`'record'` or `'master'`) for a row answered `locked: true`, and exposes `heldByMaster(recordId)`. It answers `true` only for a row a read answered `lockSource: 'master'`. A 501, a `null` entry, a failed or unasked read, and a record-held row all answer `false`.
- The grid's row CRUD verdict (`objectGridActionsColumn.tsx`) ANDs `!heldByMaster` into `canDelete`. The row menu, the row context menu and the list page's single-row selection bar all read the same `rowActionMenuProps`, so they all drop Delete on a master-held line. A record-held row keeps Delete and loses Edit, as before (#13568).
- `ObjectGrid.tsx`: the lock hook is also enabled, and the demand probe also sent, on a grid whose rows offer Delete but no Edit (`rowMenuReadsLocks = (canEdit && onEdit) || (canDelete && onDelete)`). Without this, a Delete-only grid never read the lock and kept Delete on a master-held line. The read is still sent only on demand, never on first paint.
- The column docblock and the `ObjectGrid.tsx` hook comment no longer say that a master-held line keeps Edit and Delete.
- One `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-grid`.

Read first, in order of risk:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, the `rowMenuReadsLocks` hunk: a Delete-only grid now sends a lock read when a row's actions are reached for.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useRowApprovalLocks.ts`, the `answered.set` hunk: `lockSource` is kept only on a `locked: true` entry, and only for one of the two values.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridActionsColumn.tsx`, the `canDelete` line.

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/rowMenuApprovalLock-36911.test.tsx` should report 10 passed, including the three tests under `objectstack#37231`.

## Tests

The new pins are a top-level `describe` in the existing harness `rowMenuApprovalLock-36911.test.tsx`:
- A master-held line offers neither Edit nor Delete. A record-held sibling offers no Edit and keeps Delete. An open sibling offers both (the control).
- A grid with `onDelete` and no `onEdit` reads the lock on demand and drops Delete on the master-held line. The open row keeps Delete.
- On the list page selection bar, a master-held line offers neither. A record-held sibling keeps Delete, and there is one lock read in total.
- The 501, `null` and failed-read controls now include a master-held line, and each leaves its menu unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- The cell-select path (`describeCell` → `approvalLocked`) still reads only the boolean. Both lock kinds refuse an update, so the boolean is enough there.
- A `locked: true` entry with no `lockSource` (an older server) reads as record-held, which is the behaviour before this PR.
- Not measured in a browser against the showcase expense lines. The pins drive the real `ObjectGrid` against a fake lock door.
- The ablation proves only the master arm in the column verdict. The `rowMenuReadsLocks` widening has no ablation of its own. Its pin is the Delete-only test, which went red under the column ablation only because that ablation removes the downstream effect.
